name: Silicone (moulds)
volumeHint: Put your master in the mould box, fill around it with water and weigh the water. Its grams are the silicone volume in ml.

variants.sourceNote: Typical density for popular platinum-cure mould silicones (published values about 1.10 to 1.18). Rounded to the middle of the range.

variants.demouldTime: Varies by product — check your datasheet
tips: Weigh Part A and Part B separately before combining
Mix slowly and thoroughly for at least 3 minutes, scraping the sides and bottom
Pour in a thin stream from a height to help break up bubbles
Tap the mould firmly on the bench to bring air bubbles to the surface
A vacuum chamber removes bubbles entirely if you have access to one
safety: Wear gloves — platinum-cure silicone can be inhibited by sulphur-containing materials (latex, some clays, certain tapes)
Test cure inhibition on your master before a full pour

variants.sourceNote: Typical density for 10:1 tin-cure mould silicones (published values about 1.12 to 1.22). Based on Smooth-On Mold Max series technical bulletin.

examples.name: Smooth-On Mold Max XLS II

variants.demouldTime: Varies by product — check your datasheet
tips: Weigh base and catalyst separately — the small catalyst amount is easy to over-pour
Mix thoroughly, scraping sides and bottom
Tin-cure silicone can be inhibited by moisture — store components with lids on
Pour slowly in a thin stream to minimise bubbles
safety: Ensure good ventilation — tin-cure releases acetic acid (vinegar smell) as it cures

variants.demouldTime: Varies by product — check your datasheet
tips: The catalyst amount is very small — weigh carefully on a scale that reads to 0.1 g
Mix thoroughly for at least 3 minutes

variants.sourceNote: Based on Smooth-On OOMOO 25 and 30 datasheets: 100A:130B by weight, specific gravity 1.34. These packs are sold as 1:1 by volume but the weight ratio differs. Check your pack states the same weight ratio.

variants.demouldTime: Varies by product — check your datasheet
tips: These packs look like equal parts by volume but Part B is heavier — always weigh, never measure by volume
Mix slowly to avoid trapping air — OOMOO is thinner than most silicones and bubbles easily

examples.name: SiliCreate TC20 and TC40 (100:3 by weight, density unconfirmed)
examples.sourceNote: SiliCreate product page: 100:3 by weight. No density published — use this option and enter your datasheet values.

tips: Enter the by-weight ratio from your datasheet — not the by-volume ratio
Specific gravity on the datasheet equals density in g/ml
If the datasheet lists specific volume in cu. in./lb, convert with: density = 27.68 ÷ specific volume
safety: Follow the safety instructions on your product's datasheet
